description: Korean company financial figures, newest period first. Listed Korean companies from DART filings. History is shallow and starts in fiscal 2025. One page via limit/cursor. Costs 1 credit. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess) and can change or disappear when a later filing arrives. Figures follow the source, including any adjustments described with the figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.

cursor.description: The meta.next_cursor of the previous page.

id.description: A 6-character ticker (005930), an 8-digit DART corporation code or a 13-digit corporate number.

name: get_kr_financials
title: Get Korean financials
